_comment: Collection PRESENTATION metadata only. Product membership comes from the Square Catalog custom attribute named Collection (via /api/catalog or data/products.json custom.collection). Match entries by exact Square Collection display name (preferred) or slug/handle. Fields: description, heroImage, featured. order = display priority for public nav; unlisted live collections append alphabetically.
